title: Sicurezza-mi - presentazione della lista e resoconto della prima pizzata degli smanettoni milanesi
note: Read in full (Wayback, only capture 2001-12-30; page footer 'Page Last updated on Wed Oct 10 ... by zen@kill-9.it, (c) 1999-Y2K+1' -> 10 Oct 2001). Short manifesto of sicurezza-mi@kill-9.it, born as a list for Milan subscribers of ml@sikurezza.org to organize pizzate and meetings; proposes joining the Milan 'smanettoni' scene (MiLug, OpenLabs, LOA HackLab, Geek Girlz) via joint pizzate; reports the first pizzata (~20 people, 4 women); signed 'naif && Zen'. Links to the Pizzaweb sign-up by Rasta at http://www.rigadicomando.org/pizza. No personal data on the page beyond nicks/list e-mails. CDX for kill-9.it/sicurezza-mi* returns only this one capture.
